{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Drop duplicate patient rows, keeping the one with the highest sample_seq
# This ensures we only use the most recent test for each patient
trial_df = trial_df.sort_values('sample_seq', ascending=False).drop_duplicates(subset=['patient_id'], keep='first')

# Confirm the correct column name for baseline biomarker
print('Correct column name for baseline biomarker:', trial_df.columns)

# Filter for patients with severe disease
severe_patients = trial_df[trial_df['severity'] == 'severe']

# Compute the mean baseline biomarker value for severe patients
mean_biomarker_severe = severe_patients['biomarker_baseline'].mean()

# Check for sentinel values or invalid entries
print('\nSentinel values in biomarker_baseline:', severe_patients['biomarker_baseline'].unique())

# Output the result
mean_biomarker_severe"}
